items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: My mother told Shep Morrison once... What's your name? My name is Curtis Gerdy.

ctx.x: Speaking of right names, what's yours?

My right name that was given to me by my father and mother, first name, Godfrey, G-O-D-F-R-E-Y, the second name, Mayer, M-A-Y-O-R, the third name, Hirsch, capital H-I-R-S-C-H. The reason my middle name is Mayer and not Major is because when my grandfather, Mayor, Major came to this country, there was always a screw-up with the... What do you call that up there when they're coming in? Immigration? Yeah, from a foreign... Immigration. They pronounce the word Mayer, Major, like in Spanish, it's Mayor. Mayor. So they…
And I'm Dick Allen, and we're all picking up, and we're on the first reel. What's today's date?
